newsitem.title: USA: PP&L's Susquehanna 2 nuke returns to service.
newsitem.headline: PP&L's Susquehanna 2 nuke returns to service.

text.p: Pennsylvania Power & Light Co said its Unit 2 reactor at the Susquehanna nuclear power plant near Berwick returned to service on Saturday, following a refueling and maintenance outage.
During the outage, about 40 percent of the unit's uranium fuel was replaced, according to Herbert Woodeshick, Pennsylvania Power & Light Co's special assisant to the president.
Unit 2 will now be on a 24-month refueling cycle. Previously, the unit was refueled every 18 months.

The company said the longer run cycle is made possible by using a new fuel design with a higher energy content and improved safety margins. The new fuel design will increase the unit's availability while maintaining a high level of safety at the plant, PP&L said.
Unit 1 at the plant is expected to be converted to the 24-month cycle during its next refueling outage in Spring 1998, the company said.
